name: Esri
title: Ancestor of Jesus in Luke's genealogy
summary: Esri is a person mentioned in the genealogy of Jesus Christ. He is the son of Naggai and the father of Nahum. Little is known about his life beyond his place in Jesus' family tree, but his role in the lineage highlights God's faithful plan through generations.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Jesus' genealogy
keyEvents.description: Esri is mentioned as part of Jesus' genealogy in the Gospel of Luke, between Naggai and Nahum. This places him in the messianic lineage.

keyEvents.title: Part of the messianic line
keyEvents.description: Through his place in the genealogy, Esri helps fulfill God's promise of a Savior who would come through David's line.

keyEvents.title: Connection to David's royal line
keyEvents.description: Esri is part of the long lineage that stretches from David through the line of Nathan, and which ultimately leads to Jesus Christ.

keyEvents.title: God's Faithfulness Through Generations
keyEvents.description: Esri's presence in the genealogy testifies that God preserved the messianic lineage through many generations, even during periods with little biblical documentation.
